params.name: Points
params.description: Control points as x y z triples in world coordinates, separated by semicolons. The curve passes through each one; Edit Handles lets you drag them in the viewport.

params.name: Segments
params.description: Number of straight pieces sampled between each pair of control points. Higher values give a smoother curve.

params.name: Thickness
params.description: Width of the curve's square cross-section in world units.
